services.value: Provides cleanroom testing and certification services, including cleanroom certification (particle counts, HEPA filter integrity, viable air/surface sampling, and room qualification IQ/OQ/PQ) as well as equipment certification (e.g., biosafety cabinets, fume hoods, and laminar flow hoods). Also offers facility qualification, including URS/DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ and certification/mapping for controlled environments and pharmacy certification for USP <797> and USP <800> with related engineering controls and sampling.
